_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for per-tier numbers. Three consumers stay in sync with this file: scripts/pricing_model.py loads it; crates/eri_cli/src/build_agent.rs window_for() is guard-tested against it; website/lib/tiers.ts is guard-tested against it (lib/__tests__/tiers-json.test.ts). Change a tier here, not in three languages. Mercury turn caps + short-window rate limits live only in website/lib/tiers.ts (single-source, not duplicated, so not here). Teams is intentionally absent — no per-seat plan right now.
